Description
The new base scaled model, extendable by approved options
The smallest one from the RHEOGRAPH family, our RHEOGRAPH 20, controlled with CANBus technology, was not only developed on modern 3D-construction workstations but of course also with the experience and potential from more than 30 years of the numerous generations before. A high rate of automation and user friendliness, a wide shear rate range as well as a test force, which might be sufficient for many applications come as a standard. Many useful options and nonstandard features can be realized.
